mentions.name: Klava
mentions.description: A privacy-first, BlackBerry-inspired iOS keyboard. It offers themes based on BlackBerry, Windows Phone, and other OS aesthetics, flick-up above-word suggestions powered by an on-device language model, gestures such as swipe-left-to-delete, Slack-style emoji suggestions (e.g. :fire), full customization of features on and off, and support for 25+ languages.
